dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hey, look who it is!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Your bones are still holding you up, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Yeah, pretty good! Feels nice to sit and relax in such a scenic place!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: But...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: But you know that I'll be craving the billowing waves of the open ocean before too long! It's where I belong.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: The churning ocean waves are the best lullaby.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Oh, don't get me wrong. I'm thrilled that you invited me here.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'll have to return the favor sometime by hosting you onboard the ship!

choices.text: But you miss the sea already?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Haha! You get me!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Days spent sailing through a storm, conquering the surging waters... yeah, those are happy days!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Sure! I'm down to chat about anything!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: But, you must be a little weary of hearing about my sea travels from all the stories people tell?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Let's change it up! Tell me about your adventures!

choices.text: Um... I fought a dragon once.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Whoa, nice! How big was it?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Hahaha, incredible!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: So I fought a sea dragon, and you fought a sky dragon.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: If we went adventuring together, we'd be invincible!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Most of them involve fighting hilichurls...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: How's that? I certainly don't see many of those out at sea!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: But adventure isn't just about how many storms you've survived in the past — it's about knowing that there are plenty more storms up ahead, and you don't know what they've got in store for ya!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Hey, that sounded pretty profound now that I think about it...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Haha, this was a great chat! And now, a toast! Cheers!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: What do you think? I wanna take you out to sea on an adventure, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I can teach you how to steer a ship if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: You know, no two waves are ever the same...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If you're free, it'd be a shame not to take the opportunity to show you 'round the seas.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Sure thing. Just say the word.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Oh, uh... And if you've got any unfinished business, best take care of that first then call me when you're done.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: One voyage takes about one and a half years, but that's just a rough estimate.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: So, you should tie up any loose ends before we set sail!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Anyway — let me know when you're done prepping, and we'll pick a date to set off!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: The thought of you and I conquering the seas together... I can't wait!

choices.text: I'm worried that I'll get seasick.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Don't be afraid. Don't let that hold you back.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: You'll get used to the ocean's movements soon enough. If you're really struggling, I have some medicinal herbs.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I guarantee you, it'll be fine. Trust me on this.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: It'd be a pity if you missed out on a voyage across the seas because of something like that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Beidou.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ah, I see you're raring to go.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Good morning indeed! Let's get to it, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Beidou.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Don't stay up all night thinking, alright? Give your mind a proper rest.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: See ya soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Why didn't you tell me about this fancy pad of yours earlier, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hahaha, there's good wine and fresh food! Good stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Come on, join me! Tell me some stories about your adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It's a bit rough around the edges, but we have weapons, space, and everything else we might need.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So, limber up and let's go a few rounds. Don't worry about holding back!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: This place ain't half bad. I like it!
